subject: Post-call recap: Novalogic exec sponsor discussion — path to pilot & procurement
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@novalogic.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Novalogic exec sponsor discussion — path to pilot & procurement

Claire — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned with your exec and procurement teams.

Top pain points we heard
- Latency spikes during peak inference (<200ms target currently missed during campaign bursts) impacting customer experience.
- Cost variability across different workloads — unpredictable token spend and infrastructure noise.
- Data residency & auditability concerns for EU customers (logs, KMS, retention windows).

Business goals you emphasized
- Reduce per-inference cost by ~30–35% for high-throughput workloads.
- 99.9% availability for production models with clear SLA and fallbacks.
- Private control-plane option or VPC in EU region for regulated customers.

Procurement path & suggested timeline
1) Security evidence hold: SOC2 summary + data retention policy (we’ll send SOC2 snapshot and SRE runbook).
2) Pilot (3 months) — Dedicated pool for a trimmed set of model prompts + monitoring.
3) Procurement evaluation & SOW -> procurement sign-off -> production rollout (targeting Q4).

Immediate next actions
- Diego: schedule an exec briefing with your CTO/VP Eng to surface business metrics and pilot charter. (Proposed: Oct 6, 9am PT)
- Diego & Marissa: send SOC2 summary, SOW draft, and a pricing envelope for both Hosted and Dedicated options.
- Claire: share procurement contact (if different from Jamila) and any internal buying constraints (budget cycle cutoffs, PO process).

Attachments: Novalogic-pain-map.pdf (diagram), draft SOW-v0.3.docx (working), SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf (evidence snapshot).

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min prep with your CTO if helpful.

—
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
M: +1 (415) 555-0124
diego@redwood.com
From: Claire Thompson <claire@novalogic.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamila Khan <jamila.k@novalogic.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 16:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Novalogic exec sponsor discussion — path to pilot & procurement

Thanks Diego — appreciate the crisp recap. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Please prioritize SOC2 evidence and our data retention policy — Jamila will own the security review and should be in the loop for any follow-ups.
2) Our finance/budget window closes Oct 15; if we can lock a pilot commitment before then it helps with headcount allocation.
3) Can you include a clear pricing envelope that shows: Hosted (pay-as-you-go), Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit), and an optional Private (on-prem/VPC) add-on? We want to see delta between hosted & dedicated at projected QPS.

Also: Oct 6 at 9am PT works for the exec briefing (CTO prefers mornings). Please include any one‑page ROI slide so the discussion focuses on business outcomes.

Looping Jamila explicitly for procurement/security coordination. Jamila — I’ve included Diego/Marissa/Priyom who will share the SOC2 snapshot and SOW.

Claire
Claire Thompson
VP, Product & Platform | Novalogic
claire@novalogic.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 17:08:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Novalogic exec sponsor discussion — path to pilot & procurement

Ack — I’ll take point on the pricing envelope and an ROI one-pager. Plan:
- Pricing envelope: two tabs (Hosted vs Dedicated) with representative QPS scenarios + per-token and infra amortized costs.
- ROI one-pager: baseline metrics (current cost/latency), projected savings, pilot success criteria (latency SLA, cost reduction %, retention windows).

Diego — I’ll need the high-level traffic profile you captured on the call (QPS, typical prompt lengths, burst factor). Priyom — please scope the SOW edits for pilot acceptance criteria + success metrics; I’ll merge pricing with SOW.

Timeline: draft deck + pricing to Claire & Jamila by EOD Wed (Sept 29). Diego — can you confirm availability for a quick internal sync tomorrow morning?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 08:02:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Novalogic exec sponsor discussion — path to pilot & procurement

Got it — I’ll draft the pilot SOW acceptance criteria and the list of telemetry we’ll require (99th/95th latency, token counts, KV-cache hit rates). Expect SOW v0.3 with comments by EOD today.

—Priyom
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@novalogic.com>, Jamila Khan <jamila.k@novalogic.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Exec briefing Oct 6 + attached evidence and SOW draft

Claire / Jamila — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming: exec briefing set for Oct 6, 9:00am PT. Calendar invite to follow.

Attached for your review:
- SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf (summary of control coverage and control owner contacts)
- SOW-v0.3.docx (working draft with pilot acceptance criteria)
- novalogic-cost-envelope.xlsx (pricing envelope: Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Quick notes:
- We’ve separated the pricing into a baseline hosted scenario and a reserved dedicated commitment with 3-month pilot discounts. The spreadsheet includes a model that lets you toggle QPS and average prompt length.
- For procurement: we can accept PO + standard Redwood T&Cs; if you need an alternate SOW flow (statement->SLA amendment->PO) we can accommodate — Jamie from legal can loop in on redlines.

Next steps I’ll own:
- Share ROI one-pager (Marissa) and the finalized SOW after Priyom’s comments.
- Set up the procurement intake call (we proposed Oct 8, 10am PT) with Jamila & procurement.

Claire — please send any security questionnaire links or a preferred place to upload evidence (S3 presigned / secure share).

Thanks — looking forward to the briefing.

---
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-Redwood-summary.pdf (5 pages), SOW-v0.3.docx (working), novalogic-cost-envelope.xlsx
